objectives.text:
Put the Explosive into zone 2. Put the Tomb Entrance into zone 5.

At the end of rounds 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7, if no defender heroes are in the Tomb Entrance's zone, you win. (Stunned heroes don't count as being in a zone.)
